deals.headline: LaLiga Impulso (CVC) money funds Getafe's new Coliseum: EUR 38m so far, EUR 53m planned

name: Getafe Club de Fútbol, S.A.D.
notes: Getafe's own audited 2024-25 accounts are on its transparency page but are a scanned PDF with no text layer, so figures cite Palco23, which read the same statements; an OCR of the PDF agrees (net turnover EUR 57,965,459; broadcasting EUR 45,950,697; sporting squad costs EUR 38,553,123; operating profit EUR 4,217,851; pretax loss EUR 882,673; net loss EUR 1,690,715; participative loans of EUR 34.4m long-term and EUR 1.8m short-term). Wages are sporting-squad costs only (non-sporting staff cost EUR 4.46m more per the accounts). Revenue breakdown: matchday is not one stated figure (season tickets and members EUR 3.08m, competitions EUR 1.7m); advertising EUR 2.68m is separate from commercial. Founded: the club states 1946 (Getafe Deportivo); Palco23 dates the current club to 1983. Capacity 16,500 is the club's stated figure; during the rebuild MARCA reported 10,500 for 2025-26, rising to about 18,500 when complete in December 2027, and AS (July 2026) reported the new stadium will be named 'Visit Kurdistán' under a deal with the Kurdistan Regional Government. Stake: 99.3% is from a Palco23 article on the Legends deal (written around 2023); Torres has been president since 2002 (Onda Cero) and AS calls him 'propietario y presidente'. Sale talks: Fenway Sports Group (Palco23 headline: near a EUR 200m purchase) withdrew in November 2025; Qatar's JTA held advanced talks (MARCA, Nov 2025), which Torres then denied were a sale; no transaction followed. Legends has a 15-year agreement to sell premium seating and sponsorship at the Coliseum (commercial services, not an investment). Shirt sponsor for 2026-27, valuation, social followers and net debt not found on a citable page. The scanned accounts also record shareholder contributions of EUR 3.5m (28 Jul 2023) and EUR 3.0m (2 Aug 2023) from 'distintos accionistas, partes relacionadas o sociedades vinculadas' to offset losses; not entered as a deal because the PDF has no text layer to verify against.

owners.evidence: quien tiene el 99,3% de las acciones del Getafe
owners.name: Ángel Torres Sánchez

ownership_summary: Getafe Club de Fútbol, S.A.D. is controlled by its president Ángel Torres Sánchez, who took charge in 2002 and holds 99.3% of the shares according to Palco23; he has said he will step down as president in 2028 once the Coliseum rebuild is finished. Fenway Sports Group and Qatar's JTA held purchase talks in autumn 2025 without a deal, so no institutional investor holds equity; the club's institutional money is LaLiga Impulso (CVC) funding for the stadium.
